answer: To stop Sybil attacks, we use Slashing Reputation Escrow. First, every agent must deposit $5,000 in liquid bonds. Second, decentralized peers validate every single compute output. Third, if an agent attempts a double-spend or fake task, the entire bond is instantly burned. An attacker must spend $50,000 per fake node and endure 60 days of verification lag. This mechanism acts like a deep riverbed of quartz, where only the most solid crystal-clear truths remain after the turbulent currents of deception are washed away by the heavy, crushing weight of financial loss.
